usage: cox route priority [-h] [--profile PROFILE]
                          [--set N | --up | --down | --top | --bottom]
                          [initiative]

positional arguments:
  initiative         required with a flag; omit it to list the open queue

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  --profile PROFILE
  --set N            write N on every item
  --up               pass the nearest higher open initiative
  --down             pass the nearest lower open initiative
  --top              one above every other open initiative
  --bottom           one below every other open initiative
